mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% indicates aggressive monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate decline below 7.5% signals labor market tightening, increasing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when UNRATE < 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts growth (HOUST > 950k) and GDP expansion (GDPC1 > 13,500) indicate robust consumer demand, increasing corporate revenue expectations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of rising HOUST and GDPC1 fails to produce positive returns in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 3.0% triggers central bank rate hikes that increase equity discount rates, reducing valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth (INDPRO > 98.5) indicates manufacturing expansion, increasing corporate output and profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to produce positive returns in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales growth above 400,000 million dollars (RSAFS > 400,000) signals strong consumer spending, accelerating corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when RSAFS > 400,000 million dollars.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS > 135,000k) and unemployment rate decline (UNRATE < 7.8%) indicate labor market strength, boosting wage growth and consumer spending for positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of PAYEMS growth and UNRATE < 7.8% fails to produce positive returns in >50% of 5-day windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 950,000 units (HOUST > 950k) indicates housing market recovery, increasing construction activity and consumer confidence for positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when HOUST > 950,000 units.
